description: The plot illustrates the Max Activation Value across different layers for four distinct variables, comparing their trends and values. The x-axis, labeled 'Layer', has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled 'Max Activation Value', also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 1600 with a tick label interval of 200. The plot features four lines: 'attn_output' in blue with a dashed line style, 'attn_residual' in orange with a dotted line style, 'ffn_output' in green with a dash-dot line style, and 'ffn_residual' in red with a solid line style. The 'attn_output' line remains relatively stable around 20, with values starting at 17.5 at layer 0 and ending at 1221.7 at layer 22, showing a significant spike at the end. The 'attn_residual' line starts at 17.5, surges to 1406.1 at layer 6, remains high until layer 15, and then declines to 17.5 at layer 22. The 'ffn_output' line begins at 17.5, peaks at 507.1 at layer 13, and ends at 1221.7 at layer 22, with fluctuations in between. The 'ffn_residual' line starts at 17.5, sharply increases to 1406.1 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 20, and then drops to 507.1 at layer 22.
